preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n-1 and at most the minimum of 300,000 and the maximum possible edges for n vertices.
The number of special vertices k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in special_vertices)
preconditions.description: All special vertices must be valid indices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: All vertex profits c_i must be non-negative and at most 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)
preconditions.description: All edge costs w_i must be non-negative and at most 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(profit, int) for profit in output)
postconditions.description: All output values must be integers.
All output profits must be non-negative.
